decisions.reason: As a sensor module tightly aligned with the core modular platform, it remains inexpensive to carry and still offers option value because any upside can be captured without much additional commitment.

This industrial input module strengthens the established automation range and, given its close fit with existing hardware and customers, the case for keeping it exceeds the limited savings from withdrawal.

Because this server room kit is a narrower application package and another year should have revealed enough about demand, we would now reallocate resources to stronger core modules and newer development options.
The RGB LED control module is still a recent launch based on the existing platform, so uncertainty about adoption remains high enough and the cost of waiting low enough to keep the option open.
The remote access service for wallboxes fits the firm's strategic expansion in charging and energy management, so despite ongoing service costs its future growth option justifies continued support.
